description: Source code for managing and dumping frame timestamp events and histories in Android graphics system, including classes for frame event data, history, and delta calculations.

classes.name: FrameEvents
classes.description: Represents timestamped events for a single frame, including methods to check validity and dump info.

classes.name: FrameEventHistory
classes.description: Maintains a history of FrameEvents objects, with methods to retrieve, dump, and check fences.

classes.name: FrameEventHistoryDelta
classes.description: Represents a delta of frame events, with methods for flattening/unflattening and size calculations.

classes.name: FrameEventsDelta
classes.description: Stores changes to frame event data for a specific frame, supports serialization.

classes.name: ProducerFrameEventHistory
classes.description: Handles producer-side frame event history, including resizing and fence management.

classes.name: ConsumerFrameEventHistory
classes.description: Handles consumer-side frame event history, including delta computation and resizing.

methods.name: hasPostedInfo
methods.description: Checks if postedTime is valid.

methods.name: hasRequestedPresentInfo
methods.description: Checks if requestedPresentTime is valid.

methods.name: hasLatchInfo
methods.description: Checks if latchTime is valid.

methods.name: hasFirstRefreshStartInfo
methods.description: Checks if firstRefreshStartTime is valid.

methods.name: hasLastRefreshStartInfo
methods.description: Determines if lastRefreshStartTime is final based on addReleaseCalled.

methods.name: hasDequeueReadyInfo
methods.description: Checks if dequeueReadyTime is valid.

methods.name: hasAcquireInfo
methods.description: Checks if acquireFence is valid.

methods.name: hasGpuCompositionDoneInfo
methods.description: Checks if GPU composition is done.

methods.name: hasDisplayPresentInfo
methods.description: Checks if display present info is available.

methods.name: hasReleaseInfo
methods.description: Checks if release info is available.

methods.name: checkFencesForCompletion
methods.description: Triggers signal time retrieval for all fences.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Serializes frame event data into a string.

methods.name: getFrame
methods.description: Retrieves a frame by frame number, optionally using a hint index.

methods.name: applyFenceDelta
methods.description: Updates fence shared pointers based on snapshot state.

methods.name: createFenceTime
methods.description: Creates a shared FenceTime from a Fence.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the frame history, maintaining oldest frames at index 0.

methods.name: snapToNextTick
methods.description: Calculates next tick aligned timestamp.

methods.name: getNextCompositeDeadline
methods.description: Returns next composite deadline based on timing.

methods.name: updateAcquireFence
methods.description: Updates acquire fence for a frame.

methods.name: applyDelta
methods.description: Applies a delta to frame data, updating fences and timestamps.

methods.name: updateSignalTimes
methods.description: Updates signal times for all fences.

methods.name: getFrameDelta
methods.description: Computes delta for a specific frame.

methods.name: getAndResetDelta
methods.description: Retrieves and resets all frame deltas.
